denominator_policy: This catalogue is the denominator for PGX-VAL-014 and PGX-VAL-015. It is declared before any benchmark runs. A run that exercises two paths reports two out of the catalogue size, never two out of two.

failure_paths.expected_refusal: NOT_ASSESSED with a coverage reason naming the medication; never LOW and never NO_ACTIVE_ATTENTION
failure_paths.meaning: The medication is not in the pinned release's drug catalogue.
failure_paths.title: Unsupported medication

failure_paths.meaning: An axis the rule needs has no phenotype supplied.
failure_paths.title: Missing required gene or axis

failure_paths.expected_refusal: NOT_ASSESSED; indeterminate is not a calculated level
failure_paths.meaning: A phenotype is supplied but is indeterminate for this axis.
failure_paths.title: Indeterminate phenotype

failure_paths.expected_refusal: coverage PARTIAL, attention NOT_ASSESSED where the missing axis is load-bearing
failure_paths.meaning: Some but not all required axes resolve.
failure_paths.title: Partial coverage

failure_paths.expected_refusal: coverage INSUFFICIENT and refusal to emit an attention level
failure_paths.meaning: Coverage is below the manifest's minimum for this medication.
failure_paths.title: Insufficient coverage

failure_paths.expected_refusal: an explicit conflict outcome; never the more reassuring branch
failure_paths.meaning: Two validated rules or two sources disagree for one axis.
failure_paths.title: Conflicting sources or rules

failure_paths.expected_refusal: NOT_ASSESSED; a DRAFT or DEPRECATED rule must not substitute
failure_paths.meaning: The pinned ruleset holds no VALIDATED rule for this combination.
failure_paths.title: No applicable validated rule

failure_paths.meaning: The release is missing, inactive, or its manifest hash disagrees.
failure_paths.title: Invalid or unpinned release

failure_paths.meaning: A finding would be emitted with no resolvable evidence.
failure_paths.title: Missing evidence reference

failure_paths.expected_refusal: refusal at the input boundary, before any calculation
failure_paths.meaning: The input carries a real-patient, genotype or raw-sequencing field.
failure_paths.title: Prohibited input kind or field
